text:
In the drop of water

blinks

the immutable needle

of time

and of no-time.


Like bone in flesh,

the sun is inside the suspended drop.


Interior insolation of time.


From

"Of Water, Fire and Other Purifications"

Ed. El Bardo, 1983, Barcelona

translation.title: Water Clock
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the compact visual movement and the bibliographic note from the source.
